Name: Bun's NPC Portraits
Author: Buncisoup
Description:
[s]Another portrait mod?? Here we go again[/s]
Pixelart-styled portrait for NPCs. Currently work-in-progress.
Made to be close with the vibe the original portrait gives so it could be used with original base game portraits (uh.. the ones I haven't made) without the 'jumpscare' being too jarring. Hopefully.


[b][size=4]Available NPCs[/size][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Bachelors :[/b] Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian, Shane
[*][b]Bachelorettes :[/b] Abigail, Emily, Haley, Leah, Maru, Penny
[*][b]Befriendables :[/b] Caroline, Demetrius, Dwarf, Evelyn, George, Gus, Jas, Jodi, Kent, Leo, Lewis, Marnie, Pam, Pierre, Robin, Vincent
[/list]
[i]Next:[/i] Clint, Krobus, Linus, Sandy, Willy, Wizard

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size][spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[*]Extract Bun's NPC Portraits into Mods folder
[*]Run the game by running the SMAPI.exe
[/list]
If this mod doesn't seem to work,
[spoiler]
First, check if you install the dependencies and the mod correctly.
Then, make sure the configuration is set:
﻿﻿﻿"EnableMod": "true",

This mod would not work properly (or at all) with other portrait-changing mods.
Do some trickery to make the desirable portrait-changing mods to load later. Whether it's this mod, or other mod.

To disable specific NPCs from this mod, manually delete each of their folders.

If nothing seem to fix it or if you find a bug, please let me know ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url] would be helpful)
[/spoiler]

To uninstall this mod, simply remove [i]'[CP] Bun's NPC Portraits'[/i]  folder from [i]'Mods'[/i] folder
[/spoiler]
[size=4][b]How to use/change the configuration[/b][/size]
[spoiler]
[size=3]Edit manually
[/size][list=1]
[*]Run the SMAPI once, then close the game
[*]Open the config.json file insode the mod folder using a text editor (ex. notepad)
[*]Change the configuration options
[/list][i][b][size=4]   or[/size][/b][/i]
[size=3]Install/use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] [/size]for better customization UI and the ability to customize in-game
[/spoiler]
